hooks.command: python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''))" | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.pyi?$' && echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)sieval/(tasks|datasets)/' || exit 0; r=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/scripts/sync_package_stubs.py" ] && python "$r/scripts/sync_package_stubs.py" || true; }

python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''))" | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)sieval/(tasks|datasets)/.*\.py$' || exit 0; r=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/scripts/sync_meta_index.py" ] && python "$r/scripts/sync_meta_index.py" || true; }
